native_test_entries: test1: {'time': 2, 'state': {'led1': 'off', 'led2': 'off', 'led3': 'off', 'rgb1': 'off', 'rgb2': 'off', 'rgb3': 'off'}, 'description': 'Initialization phase. After power-on/reset, all LEDs (single-color and RGB) are off. This corresponds to Mode 0 (or Mode 4 after cycling).'}

test2: {'time': 4, 'state': {'led1': 'on', 'led2': 'off', 'led3': 'off', 'rgb1': 'red', 'rgb2': 'green', 'rgb3': 'blue'}, 'description': 'Mode 1. After first button press, RGB LEDs display red, green, and blue respectively. Single-color LED1 is on to indicate this mode.'}

test3: {'time': 6, 'state': {'led1': 'off', 'led2': 'on', 'led3': 'off', 'rgb1': 'yellow', 'rgb2': 'cyan', 'rgb3': 'purple'}, 'description': 'Mode 2. After second button press, RGB LEDs display rainbow effect (yellow, cyan, purple). Single-color LED2 is on to indicate this mode.'}

test4: {'time': 8, 'state': {'led1': 'off', 'led2': 'off', 'led3': 'on', 'rgb1': 'white', 'rgb2': 'white', 'rgb3': 'white'}, 'description': 'Mode 3. After third button press, RGB LEDs display warm white (all channels on). Single-color LED3 is on to indicate this mode.'}

test5: {'time': 10, 'state': {'led1': 'off', 'led2': 'off', 'led3': 'off', 'rgb1': 'off', 'rgb2': 'off', 'rgb3': 'off'}, 'description': 'Mode 4. After fourth button press, all LEDs (single-color and RGB) turn off. Single-color LEDs remain off to indicate this mode.'}
assumptions: Convert numeric test time to milliseconds; apply changed controls 400ms before observation unless explicit hold duration exists.
Normalized potentiometer positions0..1 map to ADC0..1023.
Every inferred button press is released after200ms unless an explicit hold duration is supplied.
Reference preflight required; no claim that reference consistency proves all prose requirements.
